# Coy Exterior Cleaning

> Residential window cleaning and exterior cleaning company serving the San Francisco Bay Area — San Francisco, the Peninsula, and San Jose / South Bay. Rated 4.9 stars on Google.

## Services
- Window cleaning (interior and exterior glass, screens, frames, sills; 2nd/3rd-story windows with ladders and water-fed poles)
- Pressure washing (driveways, walkways, patios)
- Soft washing (siding, roofs, delicate exteriors)
- Gutter cleaning (hand-cleared and flushed)

## Service area
- San Francisco: San Francisco, Daly City, South San Francisco
- Peninsula: San Mateo, Redwood City, Palo Alto, Menlo Park, Mountain View
- South Bay / San Jose: San Jose, Santa Clara, Sunnyvale, Cupertino, Campbell
